title: Pappardelle in Lemon Cream Sauce
subtitle: with spinach and peas
description: Pappardelle in a creamy sauce of spinach and peas, brightened with lemon juice just before serving and topped with parmesan.

steps.text: Cook the pappardelle in a pot with plenty of boiling salted water according to the packet instructions or until al dente.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large wide frying pan. Lightly fry the garlic and spinach for 3-5 minutes or until the spinach wilts and softens.
Add the peas and cream and season with salt and pepper. Reduce until the volume is reduced by a third and the cream thickens slightly.
When the pasta is ready, drain and transfer directly to the hot sauce. Mix until the sauce coats the pasta nicely. Add the lemon juice and mix.
Serve with grated parmesan on top.
